newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico arrests Gulf drugs cartel boss - TV.
newsitem.headline: Mexico arrests Gulf drugs cartel boss - TV.

text.p: Mexican authorities have arrested Oscar Malherbe de Leon, the acting head of the Gulf drugs cartel, pro-government television program 24 Horas said on Thursday.
"Oscar Malherbe de Leon is in a prison near Mexico City," 24 Horas said. The report could not immediately be confirmed.

Malherbe was believed by authorities to have taken over the Gulf or Matamoros drugs gang following the arrest last year of Juan Garcia Abrego, who is now serving a life sentence without parole in the United States.
The program gave no source for the report.
It described Malherbe as the Gulf cartel's link to the Cali drugs cartel of Colombia.
